post.title: Why She Talks to Herself by Name #shorts
post.description: Nia gives herself a pep talk by name. Milo, five minutes before his speech, thinks she's lost it. But in 2014 Ethan Kross and colleagues (Kross, Bruehlman-Senecal, Park, Burson, Dougherty, Shablack, Bremner, Moser & Ayduk, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology) gave 89 students five minutes to prepare a speech for evaluators. Before speaking, half thought about their feelings using "I", half using their own name. Raters who didn't know the groups scored the name group's speeches better, and they felt less shame afterwards. Psychologists call it self-distancing: your name lets you coach yourself like a friend. #psychology #shorts #anxiety #selftalk
